deals.title: On Running Damen Sneaker

deals.title: adidas Originals Damen Sneaker

deals.branding_marks: ZX 8000 on tongue label, TORSION on midsole

deals.branding_marks: 'AIR JORDAN' wings logo printed on tongue, 'NIKE' debossed on heel tab
